purpose: Change one coefficient for all active scalar water-level points on one boundary line, preserving raw samples and every other boundary.

model_placeholders.factor_case/model.mdu: A dedicated copy of the user's complete supported model, initially Factor=1 and Offset=0.
model_placeholders.offset_case/model.mdu: A second dedicated copy of that same model. Keeping the copies separate isolates the two effects.

requirements: New EXT linkage, one exact boundary label east, one scalar physical quantity waterlevelbnd, linear timeseries and value Unit=m.
Factor is dimensionless. Offset requires explicit --unit m and inherits the model's existing vertical datum.
No CRS, vertical-datum, time-origin, raw-sample or coefficient-placement guessing.
This recipe does not create missing boundary signals, run a solver or establish GUI/ShellConsole export parity.

commands.expected_effect: All active east water levels become 2*raw+0; raw tables, existing Offset=0, west blocks and time columns remain unchanged.
All active east water levels become 1*raw+0.125 m; raw tables, existing Factor=1, west blocks and time columns remain unchanged.

valid_FM_order: Unit = <unchanged explicit time unit and origin>
header_rule.scope: Global pre-Quantity Forcing header, not a coefficient attached to a single Quantity/Unit pair. Every active selected point must be handled.
header_rule.late_or_duplicate_headers: Public editor must refuse ambiguous/ignored headers rather than silently reinterpreting or relocating them.
header_rule.multiple_physical_quantities: Outside this bounded recipe; a global coefficient could affect another requested quantity.

evidence_basis.manual: D-Flow FM User Manual 2026.02 section7.4.8.4, printed106/PDF132; GUI attribute-table claim only.
evidence_basis.excluded: Other quantities/functions, harmonic offsets, coupled/MPI execution and scientific calibration are not established by these controls.
